text:
Jessica: Heads-up — planning a terraform apply for networking + IAM tonight during the 23:00 UTC change window. Targets: TGW route updates and iam module bump. Plan looks noisy around role/policy diffs. Need a strict pin + rollback playbook. @DeployBot can you schedule and post the plan summary?

DeployBot: Scheduled: tf-apply-job queued for 2026-03-22T23:00Z. CI run finished, plan snippet below and full link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345

DeployBot: ```
Plan: 3 to add, 7 to change, 2 to destroy
~ aws_iam_role.redwood_inference_role
~ aws_iam_policy.redwood_inference_policy
+ aws_route.tgw_route_update
! module.iam (version change) 1.4.3 -> 1.5.0
```

Miko: Can we canary in us-west-2 only at first? Run smoke checks for inference-router + auth service before rolling to the rest. Also enable state lock (dynamodb) so no parallel applies.

Dan: +1 on canary. Note: module 1.5.0 introduced assume_role behavior that can affect cross-account roles. Suggest pin to 1.4.3 for canary and prod until we've validated. We can prepare an override in terraform.tfvars to set iam_module_version = "1.4.3".

Arjun: Rollback flow proposal: if canary fails (health or token latency regressions) -> revert commit to set iam_module_version back to 1.4.3, run terraform apply with -var-file=canary.tfvars to force previous module, and restore previous route weights. If state drift occurs, we have snapshots. Escalate to oncall if not healthy within 30m.

Lina: I've taken a state snapshot and confirmed S3 versioning + DynamoDB lock table ready. Snapshot id: s3://redwood-tf-states/snapshots/2026-03-22-001. I'll own the smoke tests and pager. Smoke test checklist: curl https://inference-router-us-west-2/internal/health -> 200; POST /v1/predict sample -> 200 and token latency < 50ms.

Jessica: Good. Final ops checklist:
- Canary region: us-west-2 (single region run)
- Pin iam module to 1.4.3 for the initial apply
- Enable state lock and snapshot before apply
- Deploy window 23:00 UTC, 30m observation period
- If fail -> revert module version, reapply, and open incident #infra-iam-2026-03-22

DeployBot: Apply scheduled with variables: iam_module_version=1.4.3, regions=["us-west-2"], change_window=2026-03-22T23:00Z. Run id: 12345. Notifying oncall and posting slowlogs to #eng-oncall if anything >200ms.

Dan: One more: add a temporary route53 weighted record change with 10% traffic to new routes during canary to limit blast radius. If healthy, ramp to 100% over 15m. If rollback, switch weight back to 100% previous.

Miko: I'll be available to watch the rollout and do manual rollback steps if automated revert doesn't cleanly fix IAM errors.

Lina: I'll post smoke results in this thread and close or escalate. Planning to start manual preflight at 22:30 UTC.

Jessica: Thanks everyone. Proceed with the canary as above. :shipit:
